title: What Does an Agent Need? Bundle-Aware Agent Resource Composition
abstract: arXiv:2611.22030v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An agent resource's value depends on its backbone and companion resources and is known only after execution. Token-based generators remain tied to their training catalog, while independent resource scoring misses complementarities and reused bundles target other tasks. We formulate Task-Conditioned Agent Resource Composition (AgentComposition): jointly selecting a backbone model and a tool-skill bundle to maximize end-to-end execution utility. Our Retrieval-Grounded Bundle-Aware Agent Generation retrieves candidate resources and past configurations of similar tasks. A fine-tuned generator reads resource descriptions and recombines candidates through constrained beam search, allowing new resources without retraining. A bundle-aware critic ranks complete configurations using a large language model (LLM) teacher and historically successful configurations as execution proxies, and adapts to execution feedback when available. translated_title: 智能体需要什么？面向捆绑包感知的智能体资源组合
translated_abstract: 智能体资源的价值取决于其骨干模型和配套资源，且只有执行后才能被知晓。基于token的生成器仍受限于其训练目录，而独立的资源评分会忽略资源间的互补性，复用的捆绑包则针对其他任务。我们提出了任务条件化的智能体资源组合问题：联合选择骨干模型和工具-技能捆绑包，以最大化端到端执行效用。我们提出的基于检索的捆绑包感知智能体生成方法会检索相似任务的候选资源和历史配置。经微调的生成器读取资源描述，并通过受限束搜索重新组合候选资源，从而无需重新训练即可支持新资源。捆绑包感知的评论家利用大语言模型（LLM）教师和历史成功配置作为执行代理对完整配置进行排序，并在有执行反馈时进行自适应调整。
tldr: 该论文提出AgentComposition框架，联合选择骨干模型与工具-技能捆绑包以最大化智能体端到端执行效用，并通过检索增强生成、受限束搜索和捆绑包感知评论家，实现无需重新训练的新型资源组合与执行反馈自适应。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AgentComposition, which jointly selects a backbone model and a tool-skill bundle to maximize end-to-end execution utility, leveraging retrieval-grounded generation, constrained beam search, and a bundle-aware critic to enable retraining-free composition of new resources and adaptation to execution feedback.
